assets.logo_monochrome: use the canonical SVG logo with semantic foreground treatment; do not create a parallel logo source
assets.app_icon: canonical ClosedRoom logo source packaged by the macOS build when an app-icon artifact is generated

tokens.spacing: Tailwind spacing scale plus existing semantic component spacing in frontend/src; raw one-off spacing should not become a second token system

style.iconography: Lucide React icons with semantic labels; preserve platform-appropriate clarity over decorative icon density
style.motion: restrained operational motion for feedback, recording state, continuity and progress; existing spring timing in frontend/src/index.css is a reference
style.imagery: functional-first product/architecture/reference imagery; decorative graphics must not carry required meaning
style.voice_microcopy: concise, calm and operational; expose user outcome and recovery rather than internal service jargon

durations.instant: 0ms for state changes that should not animate
durations.large: 320ms target maximum for larger spatial transitions unless an existing interaction requires a measured exception

easing.move: frontend/src/index.css --transition-timing-function-spring when spatial continuity benefits from spring motion

spring.bounce: use only for meaningful completion/attention and never for frequent operational actions

motion_tokens.reduced_motion_strategy: honor prefers-reduced-motion and replace nonessential spatial/pulsing animation with immediate or minimal-opacity state changes while preserving feedback
